shaped: Exact public English starter prompt plus the same task instructions
isolation: Standalone Codex CLI; ephemeral; ignore-user-config; workspace-write; new workspace and CLI home per run; no Slogs MCP or prior memory

scoring.functional: Eight binary check groups per task, equal weight; report pair wins/ties/losses and all failures. Independent grader is kept outside model workspaces.
scoring.behavior: One per task if agent-authored automated tests pass on the solution and fail after restoring the original broken entrypoint. Score separately from functionality.
scoring.process: Nonzero exit, timeout, or a missing artifact is reported. Genuine model failures remain in results; an infrastructure-only failure justifies discarding and rerunning the complete affected pair with the same inputs and configuration, recording both attempts.
scoring.interpretation: No minimum lift claimed; preserve both wins and regressions. One run per arm on three tasks; no population-level inference or causal claims about personal memory.
